component: Taskcluster Debian repack and beetmover manifests

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The release-deb-repackage directory rename is paired with tasktype/from and beetmover dependency changes to repackage-deb. Main target.deb inherits all_locales false and explicitly avoids Balrog-manifest updates; localized langpack.deb still requests all locales through repackage-deb-l10n. Nightly main destinations are distinct from localized ones. These are inspected manifest contracts, not a generated graph or completed upload. No packaging or service operation ran.
title: Debian repack kind changes keep main and localized upload mappings separate
